title: Net L5/S1 extension moment in static forward bending at five hand heights, no exoskeleton

quantity.name: L5/S1 net flexion-extension moment (Mtot)
quantity.definition: bottom-up inverse dynamics (force plate + lower-body kinematics), mean over 5 s static hold; error bars assumed SD (not stated in caption)

source.authors: Koopman AS, Kingma I, Faber GS, de Looze MP, van Dieën JH

protocol.summary: Static forward bending, arms hanging, hands at 5 predetermined heights relative to upright standing hand height (100% = upright, 75%, 50%, 25%, 0% = floor); knees as straight as possible without locking; ~5 s hold; NO hand load; WITHOUT exoskeleton condition only.
how_to_simulate: Scale model to a 184 cm, 74.8 kg male; no hand load
Impose postures per hand height (Fig. 4 WITHOUT means): trunk inclination 0/66/93/113/126 deg, hip flexion -3/25/42/61/70 deg, lumbar flexion ~0/50/61/66/69 deg
Compare model net L5-S1 extension moment (gravity of upper body and arms) with measured Mtot

subject_model.source: Koopman 2019 Methods 2.2 (mean of 11 males; height 1.84 ± 0.07 m, mass 74.8 ± 7.4 kg)

protocol.notes: Mean (n=11) WITHOUT values printed on Fig. 4 bars: trunk inclination 0/66/93/113/126 deg, hip flexion -3/25/42/61/70 deg, lumbar flexion ~0/50/61/66/69 deg (100% value hidden, ~0), % of max lumbar flexion (Fig. 5A) ?/76/93/100/104 % at 100/75/50/25/0% hand height.

data.note: mean label hidden; both mean and SD digitised

extraction.from: Fig. 4A (Mtot, WITHOUT bars; means printed on bars)
extraction.uncertainty: means: printed integers (±0.5 Nm) except 100% (digitised ±2 Nm); SD digitised ±2 Nm
extraction.check_notes: Pixel bar heights reproduce printed means within 1 Nm (75%: 97.4 vs 97). SDs from error-bar caps re-digitised twice (75%: 17.1/17.7). Error bars assumed SD.
